Rybakina defeats Osaka at U.S. Open

Elena Rybakina defeated Naomi Osaka in the U.S. Open quarterfinals. Osaka, a four-time major champion, had returned to the sport after a break for childbirth. Rybakina advanced to the next round of the tournament.
